provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized bicycle at m=127, a prime with ord_2(m)=7, so the nontrivial cyclotomic cosets of 2 all have size 7. The divisor g is a product of the minimal polynomials of 7 cyclotomic cosets of size 7, of degree 49, which fixes k = 2 deg g = 98 by construction. The pair (a,b) was then drawn from the ideal (g) by information-set decoding over sparse supports, keeping weights 15 and 15. At least one weight is odd, so x+1 does not divide the gcd. H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)] and H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] on n = 2m = 254 qubits at uniform row weight 30, with a = [4, 11, 21, 41, 45, 49, 58, 67, 70, 76, 85, 98, 99, 109, 124] and b = [1, 2, 3, 8, 18, 22, 24, 38, 42, 52, 53, 62, 65, 74, 91].
provenance.notes: Distance is an upper bound from the lighter of two witnesses, weight 18 on X and 18 on Z, both carried in this file. A 24-seed randomized information-set search at 2,000,000 trials per seed read 18 on every seed. A single run of 8,000,000 trials, matching the verifier's own depth, reads 18. A search restricted to logicals supported inside one circulant block, which a general search is blind to, found nothing below 18. Folding onto the x^t-invariant subspaces leaves a lightest surviving logical of weight 54. The design point is deg g / m = 0.386.
